text_block_list.text:
Seeing Mejiro Dober feeling unwell,
I decided to let her rest in the infirmary...
choice_data_list: Don't push yourself, just get plenty of rest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm not pushing myself or anything.
...See you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Kinda sorry about that...
I'll get back in top shape right away.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...What is this place...?
Or rather—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...What is this place...?
Or rather—

text_block_list.name: Heroine Umamusume
text_block_list.text: "Senpai! Is it true that you got an offer for a modeling contract and you're heading overseas!?"

text_block_list.name: Admired Senior
text_block_list.text:
Ah... But I cannot bear
the thought of parting from you! ...Won't you come with me?

text_block_list.name: Heroine Umamusume
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
W-Why...?! Those two...
aren't they the characters from the manga I drew...?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
The protagonist, who shines in the Twinkle Series,
is invited abroad by a popular senior model—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Choosing between love or dreams...
I couldn't think of what came next after that, so I got stuck...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...What's gonna happen
to those two?

text_block_list.name: Heroine Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"I don't want to be separated from you either, Senpai.
But... I don't want to give up on my dream of reaching the pinnacle of the Twinkle Series, either...!"

text_block_list.name: Heroine Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
So no matter where you are, Senpai,
I'll do so well you'll see me on TV
and the internet every single day!

text_block_list.name: Heroine Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"You too, Senpai... please keep achieving great things and let us see you shine every single day!
You'll come visit us again someday, right?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Is that—

text_block_list.name: Admired Senior
text_block_list.text: So that is your answer.

text_block_list.name: Admired Senior
text_block_list.text:
I understand... Even if we're apart, we'll always be together!
Let's make our dreams come true, together...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah!
A-A dream...?!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Still, I see... Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Good luck, you two.
...I'll give it my best too.

Perhaps having thoroughly recovered from her fatigue,
Mejiro Dober was back in good shape.

text_block_list.name: Heroine Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
That is why I will destroy this entire world
for trying to tear me apart from Senpai...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Admired Senior
text_block_list.text:
What have I done... Just because I was too selfish
to let you go, I ended up turning you into the Demon King!

text_block_list.name: Admired Senior
text_block_list.text:
I'll take full responsibility...
As a hero, I shall strike down my beloved with my own hands...!!

text_block_list.name: Heroine Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... That won't do at all.
Because Senpai is going to live forever with me
in a world made just for the two of us...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Agh, honestly! Stop it!
You're not making any sense at all...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah!
A-A dream...?!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Thank goodness it was just a dream...
There's no way I could handle a situation like that...!

With her rhythm thrown off, Mejiro Dober
seemed unable to rest her mind and body.
